intro.title: Can We Help? Let's Find Out.
intro.subtitle: Four quick questions. In a few seconds you'll see where your work could get simpler, faster and more automated.
intro.concept: Before we brew your coffee, let's see how much time is slipping away.

questions.label: Where does your time go?
questions.microcopy: Let's find what's weighing you down.
questions.question: In a typical week, how many hours do you (or your team) spend retyping data, filing invoices and receipts, or manually moving orders and records from one system to another?

questions.label: HOW FAST DO YOU GET BACK TO PEOPLE?
questions.microcopy: Your time is worth more than endless clicking.
questions.selectionMicrocopy: Customers shouldn't be kept waiting while you're busy.
questions.question: When a customer asks for information, a quote or a job by email or WhatsApp, out of hours or while you're busy, how long does it usually take before they get a proper reply?

answers.label: Sometimes it slips through the cracks

questions.label: What if someone's away?
questions.question: If the person who runs your front desk, quotes or reception were suddenly off for 10 days, how hard would day-to-day operations be hit?

answers.label: Not at all: every process is automated and documented
A few slowdowns, nothing we can't handle

questions.label: Where do requests come in?
questions.question: How many different channels do customer requests and operational paperwork come through today?

answers.label: Just one: everything goes into a dedicated management system or CRM
2-3 channels: mostly calls to a mobile and the office email
Multichannel chaos (4+): the owner's WhatsApp, email, social media, calls and sticky notes
Out of control: customers message us privately in the evenings or at weekends

result.title: Your Coffee Check is ready.
result.subtitle: We've spotted where your business could win back time, continuity and breathing room.

profiles.title: ALREADY RUNNING SMOOTHLY
profiles.copy: Your operations already look well organised. The next step could be finding where automation can turn the time you save into growth.
profiles.quote: When everything works, the question isn't what to fix: it's what to grow.

profiles.title: TIME TO WIN BACK
profiles.copy: Some repetitive tasks and manual steps are eating up valuable time. That's exactly where the right infrastructure starts to make a difference.
profiles.quote: Lost hours don't make a sound: you only notice them when you start counting.

profiles.title: READY FOR AUTOMATION
profiles.copy: A big part of your work still relies on manual tasks, slow replies or a few key people. This is where automation can make a real difference to keeping the business running.
profiles.quote: If you stopped tomorrow, what would stop with you? The answer is already your list of priorities.

bonus.label: On the house
bonus.question: If next Monday you could magically get back 25% of the time you spend on repetitive tasks, what would you do with it first?

answers.label: Win more clients / take on more work
Raise the quality of our service

bonus.note: An extra coffee, on the house.
